answer: Every identity must anchor its key to a unique timing fingerprint: at random intervals it signs a challenge together with a hardware clock reading and the observed round-trip to three peers picked from a shared reef of relays. Puppets sharing one machine show correlated jitter, so the auditor clusters fingerprints and makes each duplicate buy a fresh jade admission stamp at full price. Fifty fakes then need fifty clocks on fifty hosts with distinct network paths - a per-seat cost software cannot erase.
